text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board. The Corporations Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board: Candidate MTC2-149; Candidate MTC2-195; Candidate MTC2-205; and Candidate MTC2-209; 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (October 14, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the supplementary report (November 21, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board.
